title.rendered: Secondary Genetic Alterations in Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma Beyond NR4A3

content.rendered:
Key Findings

  • Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma (EMC) is a rare sarcoma defined by NR4A3 fusions, most commonly with EWSR1. 
  • Secondary genetic alterations were detected in over half of informative EMC cases and were significantly enriched in tumors with non EWSR1 fusion partners. 
  • These findings suggest that secondary alterations in advanced-stage EMC may contribute to the disease’s clinical and genomic heterogeneity.
